title: Eric Davis denies alien reproduction vehicles

tellings.quote: Definitely no aircraft systems that have leveraged anything. Um and there's been no one to one reproduction.

related.note: Same subject: Davis's denial that alien reproduction vehicles or derivative tech exist. Here the denial is asserted as true, while the story says Davis lied about it.

plain: A physicist named Eric W. Davis says that no American aircraft has been built using recovered non-human technology, and that there has been "no one to one reproduction" of such a craft. People in this field call these supposed copies "alien reproduction vehicles". Davis said it in an episode with an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, telling him there were "definitely no aircraft systems that have leveraged anything." Taken at face value, his answer rules out human-built copies of alien craft.
